artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan delivering lean-challenge-snapshot.sh (R1 plan-declared Challenge with R2 git-baseline fallback), an additive `## Lean Challenge Statements` plan-format section, a Comparator-independent --check drift mode, a git-SHA immutability gate, and a real-project acceptance demonstration.

memory_candidates.content: When a verification tool's own artifact must be trustworthy against the agent that produced it, do not rely on filesystem permissions or a specs/-side copy for immutability. Commit the artifact into the target repository's git history, record the resulting SHA plus a content hash in a manifest, and pin every consumer to the SHA. Git content-addressing makes the guarantee hold even if the process-level refusal gate is force-bypassed -- a later illicit commit cannot change what an already-recorded SHA points to. Pair the mechanism-level SHA pin with a process-level status gate (refuse to regenerate once task status has advanced past `planned`) so bypass is loud rather than silent.
